airdrops.name: Optimism
airdrops.description: Ended Optimism Actions: No Further Actions as of now CLAIM AIRDROP
steps: Jump to steps Optimism Airdrop Details Latest Update: On August 19, 2026, Optimism governance approved moving the remaining 546.9 million OP out of the User Airdrop allocation and into a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund controlled by the Optimism Foundation. There is no active Optimism airdrop and none is planned. Across five rounds between 2022 and 2024, the Collective handed out 269.1 million OP. The 546.9 million OP that had been set aside for future rounds, roughly 12.7% of total supply and about $50 million at the time of the vote, will now go toward partnership deals, liquidity incentives on OP Mainnet, and contracts that bring institutions onto the OP Stack. The Foundation’s reasoning was that broad user airdrops fit an earlier phase built around mass user acquisition and do not match its current institutional strategy. It did leave the door open, saying it would revisit the position if new airdrop designs address the retention problems its own research found. Tokens already claimed from Airdrops 1 through 5 are untouched and will not be clawed back. The vote was close and contested. It finished at 17,973,915 OP in favor against 10,930,696 opposed, or about 62%. Test in Prod, a core development team that describes itself as fully funded by the Collective, cast 8.486 million OP in support with under 17 minutes left, taking approval from 45.77% to 61.84%. Without that vote the proposal would have failed at 46.47% and the tokens would have stayed with users. L2BEAT and delegate polynya both voted against, arguing the fund’s mandate was too open

ended for an allocation of that size. Optimism’s Five Airdrops Airdrop 1 landed in May 2022 and went to roughly 250,000 addresses based on early bridge use, DAO voting, and gas spent on Ethereum. Later rounds narrowed sharply: Airdrop 5, snapshotted on September 15, 2024, sent 10 million OP to just over 54,000 wallets that had been active on OP Mainnet and delegated their voting power. The SuperStacks campaign, which ran until June 30, 2025 and awarded XP for using interoperable assets like USDT0 across OP Chains, has also concluded. Claiming for that campaign is closed. What This Means if You Farm OP Stack Chains Activity on OP Mainnet no longer builds toward an OP allocation. There is no points program, no snapshot, and no reserved supply behind it. Wallets that were farming Optimism itself in the hope of a sixth drop should treat that thesis as dead until the Foundation says otherwise. Individual Superchain chains are a different story, since they run their own tokenomics. Ink has confirmed an INK airdrop, while Base and Soneium remain among the more watched unconfirmed L2 farms. Our 2026 airdrop tier list covers where those stand, the Base ecosystem page tracks tokenless projects building there, and the confirmed airdrops list covers programs that already have an announced token and a claim window. Important Terms Superchain : The network of Layer 2 chains built on the OP Stack that share security assumptions and can pass messages between each other. Strategic Ecosystem Fund : The new OP allocation category created by the August 2026 vote, spent by the Foundation on partnerships and incentives rather than distributed to users. Voting power snapshot : The block at which delegate balances are recorded. For this proposal it was taken on August 13, 2026, a week before voting closed, so OP acquired afterward could not affect the outcome. Frequently Asked Questions Is there still an Optimism airdrop in 2026? No. Optimism has no active or planned user airdrop. Governance voted on August 19, 2026 to move the last 546.9 million OP out of the airdrop allocation, which removed the dedicated supply that future rounds would have come from. Can I still claim OP from earlier airdrops? Claim windows for Airdrops 1 through 5 have closed, and the SuperStacks campaign ended in 2025. Tokens already distributed in those rounds are unaffected by the governance vote and stay in the wallets that claimed them. Will Optimism ever do another airdrop? The Foundation has not ruled it out permanently. It said airdrops do not suit its current growth priorities but that it would reconsider if new designs emerge that fix the retention issues its research identified. Any future round would need a fresh governance vote and a new allocation. Does farming OP Mainnet still make sense? Not for an OP token allocation, since none exists. Using OP Mainnet can still qualify you for airdrops from individual protocols deployed there, each of which runs its own reward program independently of the Optimism Foundation.

steps: Jump to steps Trade to Earn is a live campaign that returns 100% of your trading fees, paid in USDC and $EDGE. On top of the fee rebate, trading volume earns Mystery Boxes. Reach 100,000 to 200,000 USDC in cumulative volume and you receive a Basic Box, and each box holds a random reward with top prizes worth up to 300,000 USDC. Boxes are handed out weekly, so the more volume you trade, the more boxes you collect.

Migrate Your Fireplace Account Create a Polymarket account if you don’t already have one Cancel any resting limit orders on Fireplace so your funds are free to move In Polymarket, open your profile and copy your Copy address (not the Deposit address), then paste it into the migration page and confirm The migration moves all open positions and your full cash balance in one on
chain transaction. It can’t be reversed, so double
check the address before confirming. Support is available through the Fireplace Discord , but only until the site shuts off.
